#  | Doughmination Docs

> This is documentiation for my various projects and code.

- [Welcome](https://docs.doughmination.gay/index.md): Welcome
- [FAQ](https://docs.doughmination.gay/faq.md): They are served from my CDN, which is a Cloudflare Pages project.

## Projects

### Sandrone

- [Sandrone](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone.md): Sandrone is an all-in-one Discord bot: lookups, text and developer tools, media embeds, pride flag avatars, YouTube downloads, and a handful of things that exist purely for fun.
- [Commands](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/commands.md): Everything Sandrone answers to. All of them are slash commands, so Discord will fill in the options for you as you type.
- [Adding Sandrone](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/setup.md): Sandrone can be added two different ways, and they are not the same thing.
- [Official links](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/official-links.md): Discord bots get impersonated. A copied avatar, a copied name and a link to somewhere that wants your password is a two-minute job, so this page is the reference for what the real Sandrone actually looks like and where it will actually send you.
- [Hosted downloads](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/downloads.md): /yt-dlp is the one command that leaves something on disk. This page explains exactly what, where, for how long, and who can reach it — because "the bot hosts a file for you" deserves more than a footnote.
- [Pride flags](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/flags.md): /pride wraps a pride flag around a profile picture. Thirty flags, two at once if you like, still or spinning, with enough knobs to get something that actually looks good rather than something that merely exists.
- [Unit reference](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/units.md): Every unit /convert knows, by category. Around 100 of them across 12 categories.
- [Error messages](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/errors.md): What Sandrone says when something goes wrong, and what it actually means. Most of these are the bot telling you something useful rather than falling over.
- [Development](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/development.md): How Sandrone is put together, and how to run it locally if you're contributing.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/tos.md): Effective 6 September 2026
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/privacy.md): Effective 11 September 2026

### pkviewer

- [pkviewer](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer.md): pkviewer turns a PluralKit system into a website.
- [Claiming a system](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/claiming.md): Claiming a system on pkviewer lets you manage how it appears on the web. It is not ownership of the PluralKit system itself — PluralKit remains in charge of the identity and the data.
- [Your public address](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/addresses.md): Every claimed system is public straight away, at its PluralKit ID:
- [Appearance and layout](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/appearance.md): pkviewer separates two things that are easy to confuse:
- [Badges and credits](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/badges.md): pkviewer has two ways of recognising people, and they are separate on purpose.
- [CSS reference](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/css.md): Custom CSS lets you style your pages by hand, from Advanced CSS in your system's management pages.
- [Privacy](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/pkviewer/privacy.md): pkviewer is a presentation layer over PluralKit. Most of what appears on a pkviewer page is not pkviewer's to begin with — it belongs to PluralKit, and pkviewer only shows what PluralKit already makes public.
- [Doughmination Music](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/doughmination-music.md): Doughmination Music is a free public player.
